summary.text: Dylan Fernandes is a Democratic state senator representing the Plymouth and Barnstable District, in office since January 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2017 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Dylan Fernandes earned a bachelor's degree in economics and political science from the College of Charleston and a graduate degree in public administration from Harvard University.
His career experience includes working on Maura Healey's 2014 campaign for Attorney General and serving in the Civil Rights Division of the Attorney General's Office.

Fernandes represented the Barnstable, Dukes, and Nantucket District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2017 to 2025 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2025, succeeding Susan Moran.

In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Agriculture and Fisheries and was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Cannabis Policy and the Joint Committee on Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
